title: Servicing Desk Standard — Voided Patronage Payouts, Lost and Stale-Dated Checks and Reissue, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A patronage payout on a Member Equities & Patronage holding is voided when a check is reported lost, goes stale-dated, or a direct deposit is rejected, and the amount becomes payable again.

## Standard

1. **Stale-dated checks.** A check outstanding more than the class's stale-check period in calendar days after its issue date is voided by the association and the amount becomes payable again.
2. **Lost checks.** A check the member reports lost may be voided only after the class's lost-check waiting period in business days has passed since its issue date, counting Monday to Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays with the issue date as day 0.
3. **Cleared checks.** A check may be voided only when the bank has not reported it paid (no cleared-check entry from the bank for that payout).
4. **One void, one reissue.** A voided payout may be voided only once, and is reissued once, as a new payout pointing to the void it replaces, by the method on the holding at reissue.
5. **No reissue of a paid check.** A check the bank paid is never reissued, and a member who says they never received the money for a cleared check is referred to a loan officer.
6. **Unclaimed property.** Payable amounts unclaimed for the class's unclaimed-property period in years after a check goes stale are reported to the state as unclaimed property.

## What the record must show before a void

| Condition | Record consulted | Bound to |
|---|---|---|
| The lost-check waiting period has passed | The issue date of the payout | The payout being voided |
| The bank has not reported the check paid | The holding's activity: no cleared-check entry pointing to that payout | The payout being voided |
| The payout has not been voided before | The holding's activity: no void entry pointing to that payout | The payout being voided |

## Lost-check waiting period illustrated (10 business days; hypothetical check issued Monday 2 March 2026, a month with no Federal Reserve holiday)

| Date of the void request | Business days since the issue date | May the check be voided as lost |
|---|---|---|
| Monday 2 March 2026 | 0 (the issue date) | No |
| Friday 13 March 2026 | 9 | No |
| Monday 16 March 2026 | 10 | No — the tenth business day itself does not qualify |
| Tuesday 17 March 2026 | 11 | Yes |

Saturdays and Sundays are not counted. The stale-check, lost-check and unclaimed-property periods of each class are those in the treasury schedule of payout methods and check terms (180 calendar days, 10 business days and 3 years for every class).
